description: This Java class models the EmployeeProjectV2 entity, mapping to the 'employee_project' table in the database, representing the relationship between employees and projects with start and end dates.

classes.name: EmployeeProjectV2
classes.description: Entity class representing the link between Employee and Project with start and end dates.

methods.name: getDateStarted
methods.description: Returns the date when the employee started the project.

methods.name: setDateStarted
methods.description: Sets the start date for the employee's project assignment.

methods.name: getDateEnded
methods.description: Returns the date when the employee ended the project.

methods.name: setDateEnded
methods.description: Sets the end date for the employee's project assignment.

methods.name: getPrimaryKey
methods.description: Returns the composite primary key object EmployeeProjectId.

methods.name: setPrimaryKey
methods.description: Sets the composite primary key object EmployeeProjectId.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee associated with this project assignment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with this project assignment.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves the Project associated with this employee assignment.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project object with this employee assignment.
